 New Switch 2, Switch System Software Update Reveals Return Of Gifting Next Week
 by Donald Theriault - November 9, 2026, 9:12 pm EST 
 Discuss in talkback! 
 Source: Nintendo 
 Dom Turetto approves of the gifting feature this time.
 Switch 2 and Switch have a new system software update that will bring back a feature for the first time since the Wii Shop's closure.
 The 23.5 update patch notes include the groundwork for an eShop update due next week that will re-enable gifting of eShop games. Unlike when the function was present on the Wii, the Switch 2 and Switch versions will be limited to users within the same Nintendo Switch Online family group.
 The update also adds the Switch 2's accessibility menu options to the initial setup process, including the option to enable text-to-speech and larger font sizes. Nintendo recently joined the Accessible Games Initiative in an attempt to make their systems more usable for users with injuries or disabilities that may make games harder to play.
